description: russia-colonialism techniques used by Manipulative Referendum on the Preservation of the USSR (March 1991), ATT&CK campaign C0093 (v1.1)
name: Manipulative Referendum on the Preservation of the USSR (March 1991) (C0093)

techniques.comment: A referendum with a vague formulation to legitimize union control: the ballot of the 17 March 1991 referendum asked voters to endorse "the preservation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics as a renewed federation of equal sovereign republics"(Citation: Постановление ВС СССР об организации референдума 1991) – even though the content of the "renewed federation" was nowhere defined, while the result was then used as a mandate for a new union treaty.
